steps.content: Only one staircase connects to Julien's office. You walk down it and exit the narrow path into the overhead passage sitting atop the square.

The broadcasting station is near, and the central square's food stalls are a few dozen meters below. Although the night market is open, the place is not as clamorous and crowded as yesterday. The entire space is drowned in an odd anxiety.
The Executive Committee's raid scared ordinary inhabitants, and in places they're not yet aware of, Mania is spreading unnoticeably.
No response. You try to sense the location of the contamination source, but in vain. It seems like you'll have to investigate by following one clue after another.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Lavina!
The shout interrupts your thoughts. Hella is waving at the red-haired woman waiting on the other end of the bridge. It's the woman who took her to the canteen not long ago.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I haven't introduced myself. My name is Lavina, and I'm a logistics officer here. I'm only in charge of food and not the guns. I also dislike fights.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Were the wraps good? If you haven't had enough, I can make you some more.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...You despise Mania but not the Sinners?
Hecate's vigilance doesn't offend the woman and only sends her into deep thoughts.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Did Sinners do anything wrong?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Oh, Dudu likes to scam people for money. Those three from Whitestone never pay their debts. There's also that con artist who only knows to bluff, and... alright, the Sinners we have here aren't very presentable.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: But look how cute little Hella is. People adore her energy and can't help coddling her.
You glimpse at Hella's expression. She seems to have already lowered her guard. Apparently, Lavina is good at easing others' nerves... Is this also his arrangement?

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: Alright, I know you're already tired of my rambling. Come, the closest site for your investigation is not far, and it's been kept as it is since the incident happened.
She leads you across the bridge, onto the railcar, down the elevator, and finally you arrive at the other end of the commercial district. There are fences to seal this area.
The inhabitants are evacuated in time. Dressed in thick cloaks, a dozen armed personnel are pointing their guns at a dark alley and firing anti-Mania shots into it, triggering nauseating growls.

steps.speaker: Armed Personnel
steps.content: ...Inside.
There are no signs of monsters in there, but the pitch-dark alley indeed gives off an unpleasant yet familiar atmosphere.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: The Corruptors were already killed and the contamination has been mostly cleaned up, but I didn't expect to see a sign of resurgence today.

steps.speaker: Lavina
steps.content: I'll leave the rest to you, Mr. Expert.
steps.female_content: I'll leave the rest to you, Miss Expert.
